name: jira-work-items-native-family
$comment: CHAOS-3704 provider-local parity slice. Each mutation removes one Jira completeness, pagination, or tenant fence and must drive its direct proof red before restore.

mutations.rationale: A Jira comments or sprint child failure is typed as incomplete and must withhold the watermark; advancing it would permanently skip the retry window.

Every non-empty direct effect must be fenced to the claimed tenant before write or readback; removing the final org equality clause must be killed by the foreign-tenant write assertion, while preserving valid-row writes.
Jira must fail closed when a non-terminal page omits its continuation token; returning success would advance a watermark over an incomplete inventory.

The Atlassian route must retain non-empty worklog enrichment when the dataset option is enabled; dropping the fetch branch silently loses time accounting while all canonical work-item lists still pass.
Board sprint enumeration is the only Atlassian source for uncached sprints; removing this branch must be killed by the non-empty board sprint assertion and request evidence.
Issue-link edges are a persisted direct destination, not optional decoration; the canonical edge assertion must fail when the dependency normalizer is made empty.
Comment interactions must survive the Atlassian enrichment path when requested; an empty interaction list is a false pass unless the direct persisted interaction count fails.
A complete Atlassian run advances the watermark and an optional child failure withholds it; flipping this predicate must fail the successful non-empty route proof and the typed failure proof.
